items.claim: this physiotherapy protocol restores shoulder range of motion

cases.text: One: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 4 March; by 29 March shoulder abduction ran 14 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Two: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 5 March; by 30 March shoulder abduction ran 11 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Three: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 6 March; by 31 March shoulder abduction ran 16 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Four: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 7 March; by 28 March shoulder abduction ran 9 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.

items.passage:
A rehabilitation register records four ward intakes that completed the same physiotherapy protocol.
One: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 4 March; by 29 March shoulder abduction ran 14 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Two: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 5 March; by 30 March shoulder abduction ran 11 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Corticosteroid injections at each hospital held level with the earlier quarter, and every intake was cleared to receive them. Averages cover every patient in each intake, last values carried forward, and a quarter of each intake missed the follow-up clinic.
Three: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 6 March; by 31 March shoulder abduction ran 16 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Four: Marbeck ward, rotator cuff cases, spring, treated 7 March; by 28 March shoulder abduction ran 9 degrees above the same ward a quarter earlier; therapist Ferrand.
Measurements were entered in the register by a duty therapist and countersigned by a clerk.
items.notes: Check that all four intakes share hospital, injury type, season and therapist - one distinct value per dimension. The closer names the obvious rival cause (corticosteroid injections tripling) and then blocks it: every intake was medically barred from receiving them, so the ward-against-itself comparison still supports the claim.

The claim is about the protocol restoring shoulder range of motion for the patients put on it, so the population is the whole intake and the register covers three quarters of it. All four intakes are rotator cuff cases on the Marbeck ward in one spring and each loses the same quarter, so no case in the register measures the patients the others missed.
items.notes: Cases are identical to coherent_true; only the closer differs, and only in its second clause. Check that the corticosteroid rise is one cause covering all four records at once, and that it works only because every record is the same ward in the same spring. The fact clause is shared verbatim with coherent_true and the scope clause is shared verbatim with diverse_true, so no single clause marks the label.
